events.title: Satoru Mikami's Death & Reincarnation
events.description: Satoru Mikami, a 37-year-old corporate worker, dies and is reincarnated as a slime in the Great Jura Forest with unique abilities.
consequences: Acquisition of unique skills: Great Sage and Predator
Beginning of the Tempest legend
First contact with the sealed Storm Dragon Veldora

events.title: Goblin Village Alliance
events.description: Rimuru saves a goblin village from dire wolves and forms the first alliance, becoming their leader.
consequences: Formation of the first Tempest settlement
Naming of goblins and wolves, evolution begins
Establishment of Rimuru as a leader figure

events.title: Orc Lord Invasion
events.description: The Orc Lord leads a massive army threatening the forest. Rimuru forms an alliance with the Lizardmen and Ogres to stop the invasion.
consequences: Population spike: 150,000+ orcs join Tempest
Military restructuring and organization
Establishment of Tempest as a major power
Integration of multiple monster races

events.title: Tempest Massacre
events.description: The Kingdom of Falmuth attacks Tempest while Rimuru is away, resulting in the deaths of many citizens including Shion.
consequences: Rimuru's transformation into a True Demon Lord
Resurrection of fallen citizens
Destruction of Falmuth's army
Global recognition of Tempest's power

events.title: Demon Lord Awakening
events.description: Rimuru evolves into a True Demon Lord through the Harvest Festival, gaining immense power and transforming Tempest forever.
consequences: Global diplomacy shift - Tempest becomes a recognized nation
Formation of the Octagram (Eight Star Demon Lords)
Massive power increase for all Tempest citizens
Establishment of international relations

events.title: First Walpurgis Council
events.description: Rimuru attends his first Walpurgis as a newly awakened Demon Lord, meeting the other members of the Octagram and establishing his position in the supernatural hierarchy.
consequences: Official recognition as a True Demon Lord
Formation of alliances with Guy Crimson and Milim
Clayman's defeat and removal from power
Establishment of Tempest's international standing

events.title: Empire Invasion
events.description: The Eastern Empire launches a massive invasion against Tempest, underestimating the power of the newly awakened Demon Lord and his evolved subordinates.
consequences: Demonstration of Tempest's overwhelming military might
Capture of 200,000 imperial soldiers
Hinata Sakaguchi's intervention and alliance
Establishment of Tempest as a superpower

events.title: Imperial Peace Treaty
events.description: Following the decisive defeat, the Eastern Empire negotiates a comprehensive peace treaty with Tempest, marking a new era of cooperation and mutual respect.
consequences: Formal recognition of Tempest as a sovereign nation
Establishment of trade agreements and diplomatic relations
Release and rehabilitation of captured soldiers
Beginning of technological exchange programs

events.title: Velzard's Arrival
events.description: Velzard, the Ice Dragon and Veldora's sister, arrives in Tempest to investigate her brother's freedom and assess the threat level of Rimuru Tempest.
consequences: First contact with another True Dragon
Veldora's family dynamics revealed
Tempest's power acknowledged by True Dragon standards
Establishment of dragon-level diplomatic relations

events.title: Velgrynd's Investigation
events.description: Velgrynd, the Scorch Dragon, conducts her own investigation into Tempest and Rimuru's capabilities, leading to unexpected revelations about parallel worlds and dimensional travel.
consequences: Discovery of parallel world connections
Revelation of Rimuru's unique nature across dimensions
Formation of True Dragon alliance
Expansion of Tempest's cosmic significance

events.title: Great Labyrinth Construction
events.description: Rimuru and Ramiris collaborate to construct the Great Labyrinth of Tempest, creating a massive dungeon system that serves as both defense mechanism and training ground.
consequences: Creation of Tempest's ultimate defense system
Establishment of adventurer training programs
Zegion's evolution into an Insect Kaiser
Development of advanced magical research facilities

events.title: Empire's Final Assault
events.description: The Eastern Empire launches its ultimate invasion against Tempest with overwhelming military force, including advanced magical weapons and elite soldiers, in a desperate attempt to eliminate the growing threat of Rimuru's nation.
consequences: Massive military confrontation between Empire and Tempest
Demonstration of Tempest's evolved defensive capabilities
Capture and conversion of imperial forces
Revelation of the Empire's true technological power

events.title: Velgrynd's Intervention
events.description: Velgrynd, the Scorch Dragon, intervenes in the war between Tempest and the Empire, leading to a dramatic confrontation with Veldora and revealing deeper connections between the True Dragons and the ongoing conflict.
consequences: Epic battle between True Dragons Veldora and Velgrynd
Revelation of parallel world connections
Velgrynd's eventual understanding and alliance
Expansion of Tempest's cosmic significance

events.title: Hinata's Final Challenge
events.description: Hinata Sakaguchi confronts Rimuru in what appears to be their final battle, but reveals deeper motivations and ultimately leads to a resolution of the conflict between the Western Holy Church and Tempest.
consequences: Resolution of the Saint-Monster conflict
Hinata's full alliance with Rimuru
Reform of the Western Holy Church
Establishment of religious tolerance

events.title: Church Reformation
events.description: The Western Holy Church undergoes major reforms under Hinata's leadership, abandoning its anti-monster policies and establishing new diplomatic relations with monster nations, particularly Tempest.
consequences: End of systematic monster persecution
New era of human-monster cooperation
Establishment of joint research initiatives
Cultural exchange programs

events.title: Michael's Awakening
events.description: The Ultimate Skill Michael awakens and begins manipulating events from behind the scenes, seeking to establish a new world order under angelic rule and eliminate threats to its vision of perfect order.
consequences: Discovery of Ultimate Skill consciousness
Manipulation of world leaders and events
Threat to the balance of power
Formation of anti-Michael alliance

events.title: Angelic Domination Attempt
events.description: Michael attempts to dominate the world through manipulation of key figures and direct confrontation with the Demon Lords, leading to a cosmic-scale battle that threatens the very fabric of reality.
consequences: Epic battle between angelic and demonic forces
Revelation of the true nature of Ultimate Skills
Rimuru's evolution to near-godlike status
Establishment of new cosmic balance

events.title: Yuuki's True Nature Revealed
events.description: Yuuki Kagurazaka reveals his true nature as a multiversal threat, having gained power across multiple timelines and realities. His ambition extends beyond mere world domination to complete universal control.
consequences: Discovery of multiversal threats
Revelation of Yuuki's true power and intentions
Formation of the ultimate alliance against cosmic threats
Rimuru's evolution toward cosmic-level abilities

events.title: Ultimate Skill Mastery
events.description: Rimuru achieves complete mastery over multiple Ultimate Skills, transcending normal limitations and preparing for the final confrontation with cosmic-level threats. Ciel evolves to become an independent consciousness.
consequences: Transcendence of normal power limitations
Ciel's evolution to independent existence
Ability to manipulate space-time directly
Protection of multiple parallel worlds
Establishment as a multiversal guardian

events.title: Ivarage's Awakening
events.description: The ancient evil Ivarage awakens, representing a threat that transcends even the True Dragons and Demon Lords. This primordial entity seeks to return the world to primordial chaos, threatening all existence.
consequences: Emergence of the ultimate existential threat
Unity of all major powers against common enemy
Revelation of the world's true history
Final test of Rimuru's evolved abilities

events.title: Final Confrontation
events.description: The ultimate battle against Ivarage brings together all of Rimuru's allies and former enemies in a desperate fight for existence itself. This confrontation determines the fate of not just their world, but all possible realities.
consequences: Ultimate test of all evolved powers and alliances
Resolution of all major conflicts and threats
Establishment of permanent cosmic balance
Rimuru's ascension to true godhood
Beginning of a new age of peace and prosperity

events.title: New World Order
events.description: With all major threats eliminated, a new world order emerges with Tempest at its center. Rimuru, now recognized as a true god-like being, works to establish lasting peace and prosperity across all nations and species.
consequences: Establishment of permanent world peace
Universal cooperation between all species
Technological and magical advancement
Rimuru's role as benevolent world guardian
